tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gter gyi kha byang bzhugs pa'o: maṅga laṃ: ཿ

bdag 'dra pad ma 'byung gnas kyis: yang cig gter gyi kha byang bstan: byar zhes bya ba'i lung phu na: lha ri bzis po zhes bya'i ri: 'bru phung spungs pa lta bu'i rtse: yid tsam lho ru nye ba na: man shel dag las grub pa yi: rdor sems sku ni khru gang la: de yi nang du bltas pa yis: zhi khro longs sku'i lha tshogs ni: yul khams tsam du 'char ba yod: de yi zla la rdo rje sems dpa' yi: ngo sprod gnad kyi man ngag bcu drug yod: gser g.yu rin chen bre gang yod: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: tsā ri dag gi la so na: rta gdong 'dra ba'i brag cig yod: de yi rtse bas dma' ba na: rta mgrin dbang gi sgrub rgyud ni: zangs kyi rta mgo gang tsam yod: rgya rgya rgya: bos kyi rdo mtshan 'dra ba'i 'og: ḍākki dag gi sgrub skor ni: rigs mi 'dra ba brgya rtsa yod: dbang sdud man ngag khri dang bdun gsum yod: rtsā ri'i lam yig rnam bdun dang : rngam pa sgra sgrogs lam yig dang : bsil ba tshal gyi lam yig yod: rgya rgya rgya: byar phu sham mda' zhes bya'i yul: brag ni stag mo gnam du mchongs 'dra la: bka' brgyad phur pa gshin rje'i man ngag skor: grangs las 'das te shog ser khur cig yod: rgya rgya rgya: dwags kyi sgam po zangs lung na: brag ni ral pa gnam du brdzes 'dra la: bram ze skye bdun rkang rus sha rnams dang : de'i dbu la phag mo lha lnga byon pa yod: rgya rgya rgya: de'i shar gyi kong po da la na: pha bong dmar po snying gi gzugs 'dra la: de'i 'og na dar zab rin chen sna lnga'i gter yod: rgya rgya rgya : kong po'i bu chu lha khang zhes bya'i gtsug lag na: ma them dag gi g.yas dag na: res bzhi dag la brus pa na: gser gyi phye ma phul gang yod: rgya rgya rgya: :kong po ba yo zhes bya'i la brgal ba na: mtsho dkyil bo do gcig la ni: 'chi med tshe chu'i gter yod do: rgya rgya rgya: gzhan yang : byar smad a shu'i mdun na ni:

mchod rten dag gi bum pa na: tshe sgrub sman gyi bcos ka mang du yod: 'di rnams kyi lde mig zang yag brag la yod: kun la mi bstan gsang zhing sba bar bya'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: kha tham: rgya rgya rgya: ༄༅/ /rgyal sras legs pa'i lung bstan no: dri med shel dkar mgon skyid khyod: 'khrul nas bzang ngan rtog dpyod kyang : theg chen lam la gus pas zhugs: 'di nas skye ba bcu bdun na: tshe lo lnga bcu kha ral dus: kha ba can gyi dbus kyi cha: dkar po gling phran gnyal gyi yul: gser gyi sdig pa gab 'dra yi: lung pa chu dkar shar lhor blta: gsad gso sngags kyi rgyud 'dzin bu: rdo rje'i rigs ldan yum la bltams: padma'i rigs yin don blo ldan: 'khor ba'i cha 'dzin des ma gos: o rgyan chos kyis rang rgyud grol: de phyir 'khor ba cig cho da sogs: sems can kun don de la gtod: gsang sngags snying po'i mthar thug 'di: bkrag chung rdo rje brag la sbed: gter srung mkha' 'gro nag mo gyis: gter 'di klu btsan khyod la gtad: las ldan snying gi bu la gtod: las med byung na ma sbyin cig: ces pa 'di rdzogs chen 'khor ba chig chod kyi gsham na 'dug go: ༄༅ / / yang zab mkha' 'gro snying thig 'di: kun la ma spel nyams su longs: spel drags snod min dam sel byed: de yi sku tshe tshad mi phyin: brgyud 'dzin nyer cig lnga bshad pa: gcig gis tshul dang ldan pas spel: shel dkar skye ba bcu bdun na: sham po gangs kyi shar lho ngos: rigs ldan chu khams stag lo pa: sbas tshul 'khor ba'i cha 'dzin cing : zhen pa chung zhing ngang rgyud ring : snying sdar tshe ring longs spyod chung : snying thig thabs kyi cha yin pas: brla g.yas pa yi nang logs la: sha sme 'kha' 'gro'i spyan 'dra yod: skyes bu dam ldan legs pa zhes: zab mo chos kyi bstan pa spel: skyes mtha'i byang sems min re kan: 'di yis 'gro don spel ba yod: sa la gnas pa'i byang sems kyis:

rgya gar rgya nag sing ga dang : bod yul kun tu 'phel ba 'gyur: gzhan yang bshes gnyen dam pa dang : lam bsgom theg chen rigs rnams mos: phal ba'i 'gro ba mos 'dud nyung : 'di dang 'phrad tshad don chen 'gyur: ces pa mkha' 'gro snying thig gi nang na 'dug go: athi+-i: mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (6)gter gyi kha byang*/ - PAGE 136 -- PAGE 137 -- PAGE 135 -
